LEBL.source: AIP España AD 2-LEBL, AD 2.20 'Configuraciones preferentes' and LVP section, AIRAC AMDT 09/26 (WEF 01-OCT-26)
notes: Day departures: 24R (west) / 06L (east) only for aircraft that justify needing the longer runway.
Night: if RWY 02 cannot be used for arrivals, west configuration. The AIP's last-resort east night configuration is left out (no runway closures on VATSIM).
Night configuration may be extended past 0700 LT or started before 2300 LT when traffic allows.
Preferential configurations are also suspended with braking action below good, wind shear or thunderstorms.

LEPA.source: AIP España AD 2-LEPA, AD 2.20 'Uso de pista - Pistas preferentes', AIRAC AMDT 09/26 (WEF 01-OCT-26)
notes: West: RWY 24R may also be used for arrivals at ATC's initiative to expedite arrivals.
East: RWY 06L may also be used for departures at ATC's initiative to expedite departures.

LEIB.source: AIP España AD 2-LEIB, AD 2.20 'Uso de pista - Pista preferente', AIRAC AMDT 06/26
